'''Alan Miller''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[June 2000 Terre Haute tournament]] on 24 June 2000, according to Matthew Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d935">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-terre-haute-in-6-24-00d935/ terre-haute-in-6-24-00], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-terre-haute-in-6-24-00d935/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
